context: To illustrate the power of our result, we apply our machinery in three models of computation – Congest, Parallel Random-Access Machine (PRAM), and Multi-Pass Streaming (MPS) – to three Constrained Forest Problems. Our results follow from Theorem 1 with (1) the referenced results on aSSSP, MST, and RPS, (2) model- and problem-specific subroutines for FFE, and (3) model-specific subroutines for book-keeping operations.
